name: billing_plans
title: Plans
description: The price book, and it is DATA that versions forward rather than a table anyone edits in place. An invoice must forever show the price it was billed under (docs/logic-decisions.md #1), so changing a price means adding a row with a later valid_from and deactivating the old one -- never rewriting history that customers already paid against. A plan spans all three billing modes without special cases: base_minor alone is a flat subscription, prices alone is pure pay-as-you-go metering, and both together is the hybrid (a base fee with usage overage) that most real SaaS actually sells. An internal or staff account is not special-case code either -- it is a plan whose numbers are zero.

fields.name: code
fields.label: Code
fields.help: Stable identifier across price versions (pro, team). Two rows may share a code; the active one with the latest valid_from wins.

fields.name: base_minor
fields.label: Base Price
fields.help: Charged every period regardless of usage. Integer minor units of the plan's denomination.

fields.name: prices
fields.label: Usage Prices (JSON)
fields.help: {"ai.tokens": {"included": 100000, "unit_minor": 2}} -- per metric, what the plan includes before overage and what each further unit costs. Empty means no metered component.

fields.name: is_active
fields.label: Active
fields.help: Inactive plans keep billing their existing subscribers -- a retired price is not a cancelled contract -- but cannot be newly subscribed to.
